releases.body:
## Fix

Manual `/models` selections now persist while runtime overrides are active. An explicit `/rt-model` or `/rt-provider` command can apply a new override.

## Validation

Type checking, all 8 tests, and package build validation passed.

releases.name: v1.0.1 — Session switching and Desktop commands
releases.body: Fixes runtime model/provider overrides so they update active OpenCode sessions and restore prior selections safely. Adds Desktop argument commands with actionable errors when generic session forms are unavailable. Includes native form support for clients that render session forms.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — OpenCode V2
releases.body: Migrates the plugin to OpenCode V2 (2.0.6 or newer). Adds location-scoped RPC, live model and variant selection, compatible provider replacement, and per-terminal override ownership with cleanup and expiry. Includes V2 server and TUI entrypoints. OpenCode V1 users should remain on 0.1.1. Validated with type checking, five tests, package build, and interactive OpenCode 2.0.6 testing.
